methodologyNote: Measured via social media referrals in tracked traffic.

aiSummary: In October 2026, Twitter led social media (tablet) in Kenya at 32.45% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Facebook ranked second at 29.14%, followed by Pinterest at 18.54%.

faqs.question: Which item leads social media (tablet) in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Twitter leads at 32.45% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/social-media-stats/tablet/kenya.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
